questions.question: Eight people are sitting in two parallel rows containing 4 people each in such a way that there is equal distance between adjacent persons.In row 1 – K, I, D and S are seated and all of them are facing south.In row 2 – C, A, L and M are seated and all of them are facing north.Thus each person faces another person from the other row.M sits to the immediate right of A. Only two people sit between D and S. A faces D. The one who faces I, sits to the immediate left of C. L does not sit at any of the extreme ends. Who amongst the following faces K?3020

questions.question: Given below is a statement followed by two possible reasons numbered I and II. Read the statement carefully and decide which of the two reasons explain(s) the event/observation/information given in the statement.Statement:There has been a visible impact of solar energy in the Indian energy scenario during the last few years. Solar energy based decentralised and distributed applications have benefited millions of people in Indian villages by meeting their cooking, lighting and other energy needs in an environment-friendly manner. The social and economic benefits include reduction in drudgery among rural women and girls engaged in the collection of fuel wood from long distances and cooking in smoky kitchens, minimisation of the risks of contracting lung and eye ailments, employment generation at village level, and ultimately, the improvement in the standard of living and creation of opportunity for economic activities at village level.Reasons:I. Solar energy is responsible for improving the standard of living in Indian villages.II. Renewable forms of energy like wind, solar, water and biomass have both social and economic benefits.
options: Neither I nor II is a possible reason.
Only I is a possible reason.
Only II is a possible reason.
Both I and II are possible reasons.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (Both I and II are possible reasons.) है।
